_doc: Hold-time matrix -- pure clock exits on all 303 closed round trips.

sell_model.provenance: COST-REALISM-2026-08-18.md: BUY 0.667 / SELL 0.462; a genuine bid-hit implies ~0.333, so recorded exits are 0.129 of range too good. Applied to BOTH sides.

mfe_timing_oracle._warning: BACKWARD-LOOKING DIAGNOSTIC. Knowing where the day's high sat is not a tradeable rule; it only says whether the tail was still available after we left. Never quote as a P&L opportunity.

n_effective.note: The 5 arms trade ONE shared signal (r=0.846, 95.7% sign agreement). The defensible decision count is the date+side cluster count, not the row count.

noise_band.reading: Compare against the best cell's delta vs production. A best-cell delta inside this band is not a hold-time effect, it is grid noise.
